question: Does the frozen WSP47 numerical learner generalize outside Boolean-polynomial generators and remain useful under isomorphic changes of state encoding?
hypothesis: A supplied low-degree bit vocabulary may support raw structured maps but fail after an unknown nonlinear state relabeling. Finite ground-up learning must be distinguished from universal representation discovery. This is a frozen-learner boundary assay,not a tuned replacement.
source: Start0; every64 real actions reset0; encoder fixes0. Same latent world/policy trajectory for each encoding. Identity, invertible GF2 map built by 4*width random distinct-row XOR elementary operations from identity, and random permutation of labels1..N-1 fixing0; independent encoding RNG tags. Candidate sees only encoded state/current actual action and encoded outcome; no family/seed/decode tables.

families_detail.modular_arithmetic: action0=(x+c0)%N, action1=(m*x+c1)%N; c0,m uniform odd1..N-1,c1 uniform0..N-1.
families_detail.coupled_grid: side=2**(width/2),x=lo,y=hi. action0: x=(x+s0)%side,y=(y+(old_x&1))%side. action1:y=(y+s1)%side,x=(x+(old_y&1))%side. s0,s1 uniform odd1..side-1.
families_detail.checksum_machine: half-width halves lo,hi. action0: hi=(hi+c0)%side,lo=lo XOR new_hi. action1: hi=hi XOR rotl1(lo),lo=(lo+c1)%side. c0,c1 uniform odd1..side-1.
families_detail.random_map: Frozen WSP47 arbitrary_hash World generator,information negative.

learner: Byte-identical WSP47 degree1/2/3/full equation banks and first-consistent adaptive selector. Least-visited current-state action policy with numeric comparator/tie0. No new prior,feature,search,operator,representation learner or post-result tuning. All banks/facts preallocated identically.
controls: identity and linear-bijection same latent tasks
same latent rows/actions under all encodings asserted

tests.unseen_sampling: Use common latent admissible queries unobserved by the identical latent trajectory; same sample encoded in every arm; if none,unavailable not generalization.
tests.replay: all admissible state/action pairs; all observed facts separately; wrong-known on all pairs and inadmissible pairs.
tests.cold: every bank snapshot/digest replay; corruption rejection; numerical facts and action budgets; latent rows/action equivalence across encodings
tests.counterworld: preserve unobserved-edge alternatives and the information-theoretic negative

thresholds.engineering: all inherited full WSP01-47 tests,seven or more new tests,G29/clean tree Windows/Linux; identical trace; source/action equivalence and100% observed recall.
thresholds.bounded: At1024 actions, non-affine/nonrandom families pooled unseen accuracy>=.90 for each encoding and random-permutation accuracy within5pp of identity,with genuinely unseen cases in every encoding; all observed facts exact. Report each width/family/encoding/prefix,even when aggregate passes. No unseen cases ->UNVERIFIED for generalization,not PASS.
thresholds.classification: DEV_SUPPORTED_FROZEN_REPRESENTATION_TRANSFER only if all positive criteria pass; valid misses=MIXED_FROZEN_REPRESENTATION_BOUNDARY; invariant failure INVALID. No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS or GI.

authority: External public synthetic contributor draft only. Isolated sibling of WSP48 based on qualified WSP47 to avoid importing an unfinished policy. No main/merge/accepted refs,official loop,private runner,protected first-use,controller,scheduler,paid API,integration,deployment or live action.
limits: Finite small deterministic worlds,supplied bits/actions and polynomial vocabulary.
No continuous/noisy/partial-observation worlds or learned new representations.
Raw labels and extra feature banks count; whole-process cost and absence of strongest matched neural controls explicit.
This study identifies limits; a failed boundary is not fixed by changing the frozen metric.
